native_parent_source_boundary: 本地已供研究Minecraft1.20.1 Forge47.4.10反编译源码，按文件hash绑定。该source目录无source.json；不伪造上游git revision，不声称已证明TConstruct固定提交的完整依赖解析/加载运行。
excerpt_hash_convention: UTF-8 source splitlines, inclusive range, LF join, no trailing newline

comparison_ledger_rows.input: nonempty Item compound, ItemRotation and numeric optional ItemDropChance
comparison_ledger_rows.output: loads native stack, warns if failed; existing differing framed-map registration removed before setItem(false); restores chance only if numeric
comparison_ledger_rows.preservation: Paired writer saves full item payload, rotation and drop chance. Reader distinguishes missing item compound from supplied unresolvable stack; replacement cleanup avoids stale map ownership.
comparison_ledger_rows.application_limit: Absent/empty Item does not clear existing item; unresolved supplied item can clear. This is actual item retention, not credit for rotation/visual flags.

comparison_ledger_rows.input: optional Equipment list and DropChances stream; existing Hand/ArmorDropChances
comparison_ledger_rows.output: first equipment→mainhand plus empty offhand, next up to4→armor padded empty; chance split respects already present target chance lists
comparison_ledger_rows.preservation: Complete cap method read, empty ItemStack parsed through actual schema; payload items reused rather than replaced by defaults. Current Mob reader consumes HandItems/ArmorItems separately. Exact old slots and probabilities migrated in same chain, not one per equipment item.
comparison_ledger_rows.application_limit: Over5 legacy items are not represented; empty item schema parse can throw. Existing new armor/hand item lists replaced by typed output rather than merge. No permission to alter Dynasty equipment assets.

comparison_ledger_rows.input: owner UUID plus client runtime id, DamageThreshold, full ItemStack
comparison_ledger_rows.output: server owner resolves durable UUID, client uses runtime ID; physical original stack saved and returned rather than synthesizing default when nonempty
comparison_ledger_rows.preservation: Read complete pair, owner resolver, full hurt and spawnBroomItem. Successful inventory add handled before drop fallback; owner stamp reapplied to actual saved item. Distinct rideable owned equipment conversion, not same Borrowed Bewitchment permission-list parser.
comparison_ledger_rows.application_limit: Missing/invalid Item becomes EMPTY; fallback manufactures plain haunted broom, losing custom payload. Runtime OwnerClient persisted but not durable server identity. No clear/commit transaction before discard if return drop fails; no old-world native claim. Combat damage itself not persisted, only threshold.

comparison_ledger_rows.input: stable owner UUID, holder ID, nested persistent name/color/cosmetic stack plus legacy root color/cosmetic
comparison_ledger_rows.output: loads nested actual customization via codec, then reconciles entity data and player familiar cap; absent nested optional name/color/cosmetic defaults empty
comparison_ledger_rows.preservation: Read whole actual codec and reconciliation consumers. Different from already credited learned familiar unlock set: this owns per-familiar customization and optional physical cosmetic stack while summoned/returned. Sync helper not separately counted; actual persisted tag not network-only.
comparison_ledger_rows.application_limit: Raw fromTag getOrThrow can fail, invalid holder tryParse null. Both root and nested cosmetic written, nested default EMPTY is nonnull and may override old root-only cosmetic; color only overrides if nonempty. Sync writes back player cap while init, relies owner online. Tick discards missing/off-dimension owner after20tick; no claim all familiar subclass extra data or whole player Clone.

comparison_ledger_rows.output: reader setSize(saved+1,false) BEFORE super; restoresdimensions/maxhealth/speed/damage/xpreward without heal. On dying removal splits2..4, copies onlyname/noAI/invuln/persistence and freshsizehalf/fullhealth
comparison_ledger_rows.preservation: One real entity lifecycle replacement policy: loading size without heal differs intentional freshchildhealth. No whole parentNBT copy. Combatdistance and damage depend on restoredsize.
comparison_ledger_rows.application_limit: integerMAX+1 overflows then clamp1; missing0→size1. Unchecked childspawn may losechildren; no splitreceipt/onceguard here; arbitrarycaps/progress not inherited.

comparison_ledger_rows.trigger: Full constructor, mobInteract, save/read, dropEquipment, registerGoals, defineSynchedData, control-passenger selection and gear accessors
comparison_ledger_rows.input: HeadGear and BodyGear booleans represent consumed helmet/saddle; Obsidian and ChillTime adjacent but separate semantics
comparison_ledger_rows.output: Survival equip shrinks1 only adult and previously absent part; writer/reader keep each entitlement. Body gear permits riding, head+body together allow controller selection; AI panic/random swimming suppressed by gear conditions. dropEquipment returns fixed item for each true flag then clears both
comparison_ledger_rows.preservation: One actual two-piece acquired vehicle-control owner, not one per bool/accessor or generic native saddle code clone. Control depends on both gear roles and seat ordering; persistent booleans retain paid entitlement, not original ItemStack. Per-entity settings must not be indiscriminately treated player-root durable progress. Spawn success not checked; clears flags after drop call
comparison_ledger_rows.application_limit: Original gear NBT/custom name/enchant/count not stored or returned; fixed new item by design of this implementation, not claimed lossless inventory codec. No owner UUID access gate in mobInteract; missing fields false. Full aiStep/movement/seat map and upstream death dispatch not deep-read; only method-level death-equipment consumer and control selector verified. No runtime test or production/art change.

reviews.reason: 实际物品→实体→新物品链已读，不能因只看名称而否定其物理意义。但当前新增存档载荷只是可调颜色和角度，返还固定默认灯管后设置颜色，没有保存原物品栈、稳定所有者/资格、兼容旧格式或复杂迁移/托管协调。相比已计物品框的全栈与地图替换清理、Goety扫帚的原栈/owner返还和Ars familiar双载体协调，此处构成选择性外观与瞬态分离的支持实例，不因新增实体种类再计1。未把未实测作为否决理由。
actual_chain: FluorescentTubeItem useOn 55-76: 仅上表面且player存在，server创建entity；传stack.copy给构造，但构造54-59只读取Color4，不保留整栈。addFreshEntity返回未核，非creative shrink1。
实体read/write117-133: nbt/color经Color4 load/save，angleHor单独存；writer第130行先从输出tag读angleHor再写回，会覆盖当前字段。
Color4全文77行: r/g/b/a FLOAT composite；load/save直接委托DualCodec，未见本地finite/范围/坏NBTfallback。未读取外部DualCodec实现。
实体tick82-101: 首server tick同步r/g/b/angle，客户端重建alpha=1的Color4。timer/active/firstTick不由其additional pair保存。
onHit156-163真实Tesla extractEnergy(1,false)>0给timer35及active标记；hurt136-147与空手潜行178-184都fresh ItemStack+颜色，spawn后不查结果即discard。
item184-196另有LitState组件每tick递减；没有把此组件带入实体或返还新item。未推断所有component的磁盘持久性。
limits: RGB从Color4取值但实际记录有alpha；server字段可保alpha，client同步只三通道。不宣称全部外观严格无损。
角度writer读输出tag是静态赋值事实，native Entity root rotation未读，不宣布整体朝向必丢或已复现。
35tick点亮由实际扣能触发，缺additional保存可作短时效果边界观察；不把它升级为玩家永久资格，也不单拆新参考信用。
未审核底层原生Entity/ItemStack/data component或DualCodec读盘执行，不声称事务或未知components保留。

reviews.reason: metal布尔和setMetal派生armor单独只能支持0；原生slime的size-first/load、半体型满血子体、name/noAI/invuln/persistence复制已经计入2f9bfe5ac5ca8d98a6a6，不重计。独立增量是实际装备栈经继承Mob保存后，在死亡掉落与2..4个替代子体之间作有区别的实物去向分配：已掉落先清父槽，仍持有的helmet选一个子体复制并清父槽，生成装备的低dropChance分支可额外复制。它是已存实物在生命周期替换中的具体分配/不守恒负面边界，区别于原生仅复制标量与状态。整条取得/保存/死亡/分裂链最多1，属性和父类helper不另计。
actual_chain: Armored canHoldItem124-127限制物品本来适用HEAD；finalizeSpawn93-104启用拾取机会并可能生成节日头饰。TravelersPlate子类完整92行展示真实材料工具头盔构造/修饰后装备，metal也在生成时取得。
补读本地Minecraft1.20.1 Forge47.4.10 Mob.pickUpItem/equipItemIfPossible555-613: 对物理item复制尝试装备，成功后原地面栈shrink；setItemSlotAndDropWhenKilled设dropChance2和persistenceRequired。此为本地父类对照，不声称上游工程运行时精确patch级依赖已核。
Mob.write365-405/read441-478保留原生ArmorItems完整栈序列化及ArmorDropChances；Slime.read102-105先setSize再super；Armored.read215-217随后setMetal按恢复后的size重算base armor。构造transient属性modifiers并非另存永久效果。
补读LivingEntity.die1303-1336与dropAllDeathLoot1360-1378: server死亡先调用虚拟dropCustomDeathLoot（受loot gamerule/hooks），tickDeath546-551到20tick触发remove(KILLED)。这些是本地父链上下文，不是所有cancel/plugin情形已测。
Armored.dropCustomDeathLoot130-149: size>1将slotChance上限0.25，因而原本picked dropChance2也会失去alwaysDrop判断；成功发掉落后清HEAD，未成功则继续留槽供split。
Armored.remove153-206: 不再调用Slime.remove以免二次split；选择helmetIndex、给该子体helmet.copy并清父HEAD；若parent dropChance<1，其他子体25%也copy。本地引用helmet在清父槽后仍可供其他子体copy。继承metal/状态且新size、满血，spawn返回未查。
limits: 不是无条件唯一物品守恒；低dropChance可多子体复制装备。初始生成品与拾取物的分支不能混称。
指定子体只setItemSlot，没有复制parent armorDropChances或重新setGuaranteedDrop；父物品原本必掉2的资格不会随此代码显式继承，不能宣称跨代无损。
掉落路径先随机改非alwaysDrop装备耐久，spawnAtLocation/child addFreshEntity成功未校验；原生掉落事件还可取消，故无原子提交或无丢失保证。
remove只检查server、size>1、isDeadOrDying，无独立split已完成持久收据；重复调用/异常和create null/assert禁用边界不保证。
本轮没有完整重读LivingEntity全部attribute持久化、原生ItemStack底层、Forge caps失效路径或完整怪物AI；不称完全上游native验收。
无历史格式alias/升级，不把metal或持有物权推断为玩家Clone资格；这里是静态研究的具体实体物品替代生命周期。

reviews.reason: 全文242行已核：自身新保存的是counter/facing/input，doTransfer按当前方块capability从外部库存/流体直接传到相邻块，没有此类自己的持久material buffer或未结算付款/交付收据。不能因为有物品移动消费者就把旁接策略当独立存物主。父类可能保存gadget本体/owner，但本轮不展开或借父类给这个子类加分。

IOHelper、FluidUtil、AbstractSemiblock及Direction原生校验未深读，不评价其具体原子性/owner安全。
